verdict.rationale: Auth0 docs say users can sign in with social accounts such as Facebook or X. The platform supports a wide range of login methods, including social IDs, enterprise SSO and SAML. Universal Login, a production-ready hosted login, supports social, enterprise and custom identity providers. Missing for 10: an enumerated catalog showing how broad the social/OAuth provider list is, explicit documentation that providers are enabled through dashboard configuration rather than code, and independent hands-on corroboration of social-provider setup.
